canonicalizationPolicy: Only slots and availableOnSlots arrays are semantic sets
durationPolicy: Completed battles only; rounds/actions/turns are not seconds
inferencePolicy: Mirrors are dependent; 1960 logical pair indices across versions, not 7840 independent trials. No 50-percent acceptance threshold in this initial measurement
seedPolicy: root + caseId*1000 + pair, except A_MAIN N2 generation candidates preselected through baseline actual generator in ascending candidate order: first ten K2 then first ten K3; no outcomes consulted, no enemy count overridden; same seeds for versions and mirrors
serviceCaveat: One shared generator/Battle path; actual SAFE/FALLBACK service routes tested separately
skillEventPolicy: Event counts by source side, skill and kind, not unique activations
timeoutPolicy: TIMEOUT is not LOSS; incomplete pairs excluded from paired scores
